message: the target replaced its own image and the chain of observation broke: no continuation record carrying the operation count followed, or the subject announced itself again without an exec record (an execl-family call, a static image, or a stripped environment cannot carry the count). An unbroken self-exec chain is judged; a separate process is not (#123)
